description: Department  of Labour - The Cost of living index No. for the month of July 2017, applicable to the workers of Cocoa, Cardamom and Papers growing and manufacturing Trade is being 123.6 and the special allowance in respect of a normal working day in the month of August 2017 for the above Trade is Rs. 715.38
categorisation: This gazette notification announces a special allowance for workers in specific trades based on the Cost of Living Index Number. It is issued under the Wages Boards Ordinance and relates to public sector service conditions and benefits for workers, falling under Public Service Gazettes (Type 8) which cover public service recruitment, service conditions, benefits, and administrative instructions.
